partners.mechanism_chain: GCH1 (HGNC:4193) —DECREASES→ Tetrahydrobiopterin (BH4) (CHEBI:17430); Tetrahydrobiopterin (BH4) (CHEBI:17430) —DECREASES→ Neurotransmitter Synthesis (REACT:R-HSA-1908915); Neurotransmitter Synthesis (REACT:R-HSA-1908915) —LEADS_TO→ Dystonia (HP:0001311); Neurotransmitter Synthesis (REACT:R-HSA-1908915) —DECREASES→ Phenylalanine (CHEBI:16868); Phenylalanine (CHEBI:16868) —LEADS_TO→ Hyperphenylalaninemia (HP:0002119). partners.mechanism_chain: GCH1 (HGNC:4123) —DISRUPTS→ tetrahydrobiopterin synthesis (GO:0006712); tetrahydrobiopterin synthesis (GO:0006712) —DECREASES→ tetrahydrobiopterin (BH4) (CHEBI:17478); tetrahydrobiopterin (BH4) (CHEBI:17478) —DECREASES→ dopaminergic neurotransmission (GO:0042272); dopaminergic neurotransmission (GO:0042272) —LEADS_TO→ Dystonia (HP:0001310); PRKG2 (HGNC:9385) —DISRUPTS→ cGMP-dependent protein kinase G signaling (GO:0035566); cGMP-dependent protein kinase G signaling (GO:0035566) —DECREASES→ smooth muscle cell proliferation (GO:0048514); smooth muscle cell proliferation (GO:0048514) —LEADS_TO→ Spondylometaphyseal dysplasia, Pagnamenta type (MONDO:0030487).
